desc:
An update to the classic A1 and A2 design, the BCM Mod 4 Pistol Grip employs a new form factor with a reduced angle and a new ultra-tactile grip texture that enable more exacting fire control ergonomics and operation.
In tandem with improved weapons manipulation techniques that account for accessory enablers such as vertical grips, lasers and optics, BCM AR pistol grips provide reliable and safe options for professional and enthusiast alike.
